items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: I had different boys that played, well a boy by the name of Fredo

ctx.x: He played trumpet. So there's several of them that play music in it. Oh yeah, there were four of them.
I think there were four of them playing music. Well I had different boys that played, well a boy by the name of Fredo,
he played with us too, Fredo.
